$comment: Toyhou.se's image-upload form options. Privacy/watermark option IDs are fixed by the site's own form; CharacterIds is free-text because characters belong to an individual account, the same reasoning as FurAffinity's FolderIds.

CharacterIds.label: Character IDs
CharacterIds.help: Required. The character(s) this image belongs to: open a character page and copy the number from its URL (…/12345.name). Separate several with commas.
CharacterIds.message: Character IDs must be comma-separated numbers.

ArtistName.label: Artist name
ArtistName.help: Required. Your Toyhou.se username, unless crediting an off-site artist below.

OffSiteArtistUrl.label: Off-site artist URL
OffSiteArtistUrl.help: Optional. Credits an artist outside Toyhou.se (their profile, gallery post, etc.) instead of the artist name above.

AuthorizedViewers.label: Visible to authorized viewers as
AuthorizedViewers.help: How the image appears to users you've explicitly authorized. Leave unset for Full-Size.

PublicViewers.label: Visible to the public as
PublicViewers.help: How the image appears to everyone else. Leave unset for Full-Size.

Watermark.label: Watermark style
Watermark.help: Only applies when a viewer sees the watermarked version above. Leave unset for Center. Custom watermarks are not supported.

ContentWarning.label: Content warning
ContentWarning.help: Shown to viewers before the image itself.
